verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents its own Smart Placement feature, which 'moves your Worker closer to your data for optimized end-to-end latency' and is pitched for APIs that connect to data stores. That directly matches the story's core, but the evidence is only two short marketing lines. Nothing confirms the placement is automatic or how it decides where to run, and there are no limits, configuration details, or hands-on reports. missing for 10: explicit documentation that placement is automatic and how it works, which backends and data stores qualify, any latency measurements, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on automatic compute placement near backend data to optimize latency
